title: SkillChain findings ledger
description: The ONE deduplicated findings ledger per PROJ, at specs/PROJ-<X>-<theme>/findings.json. All review sources flow into it (CONCEPT.md §7); written ONLY via ledger.mjs (skill 6_qa). PR body, debt section, and reports are rendered FROM this file, never maintained by hand.

source.description: Origin of the FIRST report; later duplicate reports append to sources[]

sources.description: All sources that reported this finding (dedup preserves attribution)

severity.description: Normalized severity (mapping table embedded in ledger.mjs). Critical/High block; Medium/Low auto-defer as debt (§8).

anchor.description: Symbol/regex anchor (preferred over line numbers — parallel fixers shift lines)

debt_marker.description: ponytail: marker text when deferred as debt
